title: Dark homes, dry taps, idle factories: Gurgaon hit by 16-hour power cuts amid strike
content: Thousands of households in Gurgaon faced power and water outages due to a strike by electricity department employees. The disruption affected industrial units, causing significant production delays and potential financial losses. Many residents struggled with basic needs as inverters failed and water supply ceased. The strike was in response to a decision to grant a private electricity distribution license.

title: On UP voter list: 'Ram Ne Yadav Ko Mara, s/o Murkh Chandra Yadav'

Notable entries include voters with odd names and details that do not align with reality. The Chief Electoral Officer stated that fewer than 150 inaccuracies were identified among 14.8 lakh registered voters. Despite the digital system's introduction, verification processes remain questioned after complaints from various political parties.

India secured a record-breaking chase in the first T20I, leading the series 1-0. The BCCI medical team is monitoring Kishan's recovery while discussing potential replacements. title: WhatsApp’s hidden instructions for Meta chatbot about 'WHAT NOT TO SAY' to users leaked

These hidden instructions guided the chatbot on handling various support queries, including account deletion and legal issues. Meta clarified that the exposure was due to a bug which has since been fixed. Notably, the chatbot was instructed not to provide any legal advice or interpretations.

title: Hawaii police dog finds missing 70-year-old hiker, second rescue in 2 months
content: After missing for over a day in Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, 70-year-old David Arai was successfully located by Trina, a skilled police dog, who led the search team through dense foliage. Found two miles from his rental car and suffering from dehydration, Arai expressed immense gratitude to his rescuers and is now contemplating adopting Trina, who has proven her tracking abilities with two recent rescues.

title: China’s 'eyes in the sky' multiply, India’s surveillance fleet faces a numbers game

This suggests that serial production of the aircraft may soon commence, enhancing China's AEW&C capabilities. The KJ-3000 is based on the Y-20B transport aircraft, aiming to address existing limitations in China’s AEW&C fleet. In comparison, India's airborne early warning capability remains limited with fewer aircraft currently in service.

title: 1890 Sherlock Holmes first edition found in charity donations sold for £11,520
content: During his life, Gregor Mendel's essential studies on plant hybridization remained largely unappreciated. His landmark paper, titled 'Experiments on Plant Hybrids', was released in 1866, and in a remarkable turn, a rare edition sold for $640,000 in 2026. Mendel's discoveries on genetic inheritance laid the groundwork for contemporary biology, serving as a potent reminder of the delayed acknowledgment often faced by revolutionary scientific contributions.

title: Haldhar Nag left school after Class 3, later won Padma Shri for his poetry
content: Haldhar Nag, a gifted poet from Odisha, faced profound challenges after his father's death, leading him to leave school. Despite this setback, his poignant poetry in the Kosli language gained national recognition, inspiring academic studies that underscore its cultural importance. Nag's inaugural poem was published in 1990, reflecting on social themes. In 2016, he was awarded the Padma Shri, marking his vital role in promoting regional literature in scholarly discussions.

title: After renaming Lake Ontario, Google CEO rejects US request to rename Atlantic Ocean

During a recent event, he mentioned contacting Google Maps regarding these renaming efforts. Google CEO Sundar Pichai reportedly declined his proposal on the grounds that oceans encompass multiple countries. This follows the US administration's earlier renaming of Lake Ontario to Lake America for US users.

title: India's WTC Final chances: What South Africa's win over Australia means

Australia remain top, while India sit fifth with seven Tests left against New Zealand and Australia. India need 62 points to reach a 60 PCT and cannot lose more than two matches. They also need at least two of Australia, New Zealand and South Africa to drop points.

Security personnel discovered that the passports of the Sri Lankans had expired three months earlier. Authorities are currently investigating their travel circumstances and intended destination.

This eco-friendly grazing method is being embraced by renewable energy companies as a cost-effective way to manage vegetation, while farmers benefit from expansive grazing land without hefty property expenses.

title: Record growth, rising risks: What’s really driving India’s core industries? | The Hindu Editorial
content:
India’s core industrial sectors recorded a series-high growth rate of 7.9% in September, driven by strong performances in coal, electricity, steel and refinery products.

While the data points to a welcome industrial uptick, concerns remain about how sustainable the momentum will be. Much of the growth appears linked to temporary factors such as increased power demand during the heat wave and higher refining activity driven by imported oil.

With global crude prices rising, foreign exchange pressures mounting and infrastructure spending continuing to shoulder much of the growth burden, economists are questioning whether the current surge can be sustained in the coming months.

title: 'Can't drive into future looking at rearview mirror': India calls for UNSC reforms
content: ambassador parvathaneni Harish India has called for urgent reforms to the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) he warns that its 80-year-old structure is struggling to address some of the world's gravest conflicts . new Delhi said the Council’s composition must reflect present-day global realities .

title: Why US banks are blocking AI agents from accessing customer accounts
content: major banks have been blocking third-party artificial intelligence agents from accessing customer accounts and carrying out transactions . banks are increasingly wary of AI agents that can perform tasks on behalf of users, particularly when the technology interacts with financial accounts and could take actions beyond a customer's instructions .

title: New Zealand military chief resigns over undisclosed ‘inappropriate relationship’
